rationale: KDA has official 2019 KNBS population controls for all 47 counties but no defensible values on the current 2012-era constituency/ward geography. WorldPop provides an independent gridded 2019 population surface. The raster is used only to distribute each official county control within that county; it never replaces the official county total.

official_controls.source: KNBS 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census

geography.rule: Use the canonical KDA geometry. WorldPop pixels are never interpreted as legal boundaries.

method.central: For each level independently, sum constrained WorldPop cells in each child polygon, convert child sums into within-county shares, multiply by the official KNBS county population, then use largest-remainder integer allocation so children sum exactly to the official county control.
method.sensitivity: Repeat the same county-constrained allocation using the unconstrained WorldPop surface. The difference between constrained and unconstrained allocations is a model-structure sensitivity diagnostic, not a statistical confidence interval.

predeclared_publication_gate.cell_rule: A constituency/ward candidate is promotion-eligible only when both variants allocate a positive value and absolute constrained-vs-unconstrained spread divided by their mean is <= 50%. Cells failing this stability gate remain unavailable; thresholds are not relaxed after results are seen.

uncertainty.lower: minimum of county-constrained constrained/unconstrained WorldPop allocations
uncertainty.upper: maximum of county-constrained constrained/unconstrained WorldPop allocations
uncertainty.caveat: This is not a frequentist confidence interval. It communicates sensitivity to two materially different WorldPop spatial allocation specifications.
